scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
恭喜。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Do not forget
that the Holy War
is fast approaching!
We must ready ourselves!
May the light of justice
always brighten our path!
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
別忘了，聖戰迫在眉睫！
我們必須做好準備！
願正義之光永遠照亮我們的道路！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
The Holy War will
be upon us before we
know it. More than ever,
we have need of strong men
and women to fight for what
is good and right.
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
聖戰轉眼就會降臨。
我們比以往任何時候，都更需要強大的戰士，為善良與正義而戰。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Will you fight on
the side of righteousness
as a Paladin?
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
你願意成為聖殿十字軍，為正義而戰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Congratulations.
As a Paladin, I hope
you will protect those
weaker than you, and bring
us victory in the upcoming
war between good and evil.
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
恭喜。
願你身為聖殿十字軍，保護弱者，在即將到來的正邪之戰中為我們贏得勝利。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[聖殿十字軍]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向戰士們致敬！
